prompt:
Create a new 16:9 storyboard keyframe for a music video. Image 1 is the style reference: match its 1990s hand-painted cel anime look, ink line quality, film grain and VHS softness exactly. Image 2 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). A transitional frame where color and monochrome ink wash meet, bleeding into each other across the frame.
Scene: Streetlights come on; SLOW walks away from the crowd into the dark end of the underpass, and the frame drains from color to black ink wash as he goes.
Camera: Wide, SLOW walking away from camera.
Characters: SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
No readable text, letters, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles anywhere.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
